svg.title: Kurukshetra — Register Gate plan, elevation and transverse section
svg.desc: Two threshold frames bracket the central passage. Defenders choose an Archive sightline after the turn through Roll Call. The plan is north up, uses metres, and locates two opposed thresholds.
